Choose **hardshell** (like Away or Carl Friedrik) if you prefer clean modern aesthetics, weather resistance, and extra protection for fragile items.
2. **Standard vs. "Bigger/Global" Sizes:** Most domestic US airlines allow 22" × 14" × 9", while some international carriers are stricter. Always double-check your specific airline's cabin limits if you fly budget or regional lines.[[1]](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/travel/best-carry-on-luggage)
3. **Spinners vs. Rollaboards:** Four-wheel spinners glide effortlessly down airplane aisles and hotel lobbies side-by-side, while two-wheel rollaboards give you slightly more interior packing volume and handle curbs and rough pavement better.
